Name: Lupini Classics - Content Patcher
Author: TheSaltWizard
Description:
I never liked Lupini's paintings so I made a simple little mod to replace them with pixel versions of famous paintings. The art was done by myself. Requires SMAPI and Content Patcher 1.10 or higher. It[b] is[/b] compatible with 1.6 although SMAPI may flag it. Please note that while this file is [i]not[/i] flagged for nudity due to how low detail the pixel versions are, several of the original paintings linked here do feature nudity. These have been labelled. 

[b][size=3]Installation: [/size][/b]

Verify that you have Content Patcher installed.
Download and extract the folder and place it in your stardewvalley/mods folder, or install with your preferred mod manager as normal.
